Prerequisite: Must have Tides of Disaster

Through training and understanding, you have found new applications to your water. You gain the one of the following (You can select this feat multiple times):

  • Piercing Water: You make a small water beam made to pierce through enemies. As an action for 2 CE, you make a cursed energy attack against a creature within 30 ft. On a hit, they take 2d10 cold damage + 2d6 piercing damage and are forced to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are knocked prone and will receive the damage rolled one additional time as a vital organ is hit. On a success, they don't take additional damage and are not prone.

  • Two water spells below 5th level. The ce cost equals the spell’s level in Cursed Energy.

Prerequisite: Must have Horizon of Captivating Skhanda

You have increased your technique’s potential. You can now use Death Swarm outside your domain without the sure hit effect. You can have a number of shikigami equal to your Cursed Energy modifier when used in this way. The number of shikigami increases by your CE modifier at 6th level (2x), 11th level (3x), and 18th level (4x).

system.requirements: Must have Horizon of Captivating Skhanda

features: Domain Expansion: Horizon of Captivating Skhanda

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Water Defensive Ring

The scale and power of the water ring surrounding you has increased. For an extra 2 cursed energy, it also creates a 20 ft radius sphere of whirling storm that is centered on and follows you. Each creature other than you in the sphere when it appears or that ends its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage. The sphere’s space is difficult terrain.
Until the technique ends, you can use a bonus action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from you toward a creature within 60 feet, making a cursed energy attack. You have advantage on the attack if the target is in the sphere. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 lightning damage. Creatures within 30 feet of the sphere have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear.

Prerequisite: Must have Forest of Disaster

Through training and understanding, you have found new applications to your roots. You gain the one of the following (You can select this feat multiple times):

  • You can transform your root wall into any of the other forms as a bonus action.

  • Two spells below 5th level dealing with nature. The CE cost equals the spell’s level.

Prerequisite: Must have Flower Field

You have found a way to do more with less. As an action, for 3 Cursed Energy you can cause the effects of Flower Field on a single creature you can see.

Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Bud

Your power has increased and been honed. As an action, for 5 Cursed Energy you give yourself the ability to drain Cursed Energy for 1 minute. On a hit with a melee attack or if you damage a creature with your Innate Technique, they lose 1 cursed energy which you gain.

Prerequisite: Must have Vermin of Disaster

As part of the bonus action you take to command your Insect Swarms, you can spend 2 cursed energy to reinforce one of your Insect Swarms with cursed energy for 1 minute. While reinforced, their size category increases by one and they deal an additional 2 damage dice on a successful Bites attack (only +1 if bloodied). If you use multiple Reinforced Insect Swarms to form a Vermin Swarm, it only gains these benefits once.

Prerequisite: Must have Almighty Swarm

You have learned to better control the combined actions of your Vermin Swarms, allowing you to learn the following ways to use your Swarms:
Insect Cloak. While you are occupying the same space as one of your Vermin Swarms, you can treat the Swarm’s hit points as temporary hit points for yourself.
Grasping Hand. You can spend 3 CE to replace one of your attacks on your turn with a grapple check through one of your Insect Swarms against a creature within 5 ft of the swarm. Instead of an Athletics check, you make a Cursed Energy (Arcana) check. The grapple gains a +1 bonus and +5 ft of range per size category above Medium the swarm is. On a success, the creature is grappled and can be pulled into the Insect Swarm.
Transport Via Bugs. As an action for 6 CE, you form a link between one Large or larger Vermin Swarm within 10 ft and connect it to another Large or larger Vermin Swarm at any distance. Before the end of your turn, you can spend 5 ft of movement to walk into the space of the Insect Swarm within 5 ft, reappearing within 5 ft of the destination Insect Swarm.

Prerequisite: Must have Parthenogenesis

As a bonus action for 6 CE, you transform a weapon you are holding. It loses all previous benefits and becomes the Special Grade Cursed Tool: Festering Life Sword. You can only have one weapon transformed this way at a time and this tool disappears when you finish a long rest or die.

Prerequisite: Must have Martial Prowess

Through much training, you gain the following martial options:

  • Takedown: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, you can try to grapple or shove the target as a bonus action.

  • Judo Throw: When you hit a grappled creature with a melee attack, you can grab the target and flip them on their back. If the target is Huge or smaller, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you knock them prone, and if they fail it by 5 or more they are stunned until the end of their next turn.

  • Flying Drop Kick: You can use an action to jump up and land a Flying Drop Kick. You target a creature within your jump distance with an unarmed attack (Calculator here). The target takes your unarmed damage, and is pushed back 30ft.

Prerequisite: Must have Extreme Divergent Flow

You take full advantage of the unpredictability of your attacks. After a Divergent Flow is landed, you can force the enemy to make a Cursed Energy check against your DC. On a failure, you notice their distraction and can use your reaction to make an attack against them at advantage.

Prerequisite: Must have Chosen by the Sparks

You have mastered your ability to target the soul. Before you make an unarmed strike, you can choose to spend 5 CE to cause any unarmed strikes you make on your turn to target the soul of a creature you attack. These attacks’ damage reduces the target’s maximum hit point (this does not include additional damage like Cursed Strike). This technique is a Reduced Output Effect that gives 1 level of Reduced Output when you deal damage to them with Soul Punch. This can cause a number of levels of Reduced Output up to your Cursed Energy modifier per target and no more. These levels of Reduced Output last until the target takes a short or long rest.

system.requirements: Must have Chosen by the Sparks

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Ley Line Command

You have learned to extend the benefits of your connection with the earth to others. When you create a Ley Line you can give a number of creatures equal to your Cursed Energy modifier the benefits of Flow of the Dragon while they are within 30 ft and touching the same ground as you.

Prerequisite: Must have Earth Dragon Soul

As an action for 3 CE, you stomp your foot and transform the ground within 30 ft in one of the following ways:

  • The ground becomes difficult terrain for all creatures other than yourself.

  • All creatures touching the ground other than you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save they are knocked prone.

  • You grant creatures of your choice within range three quarters cover until the end of your next turn with earthen walls.

  • You move one creature touching the ground with a wave of earth up to 20 ft horizontally to a point within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the effect.

Prerequisite: Must have World Anchor

As a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) for 8 CE, you stomp your foot forcing all creatures within 120 ft that are touching the ground or at least 30 ft above the ground to make a Strength saving throw as you cause a massive shockwave that shatters the earth around you.
On a failed save, a creature takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone and stunned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not stunned. Objects and structures automatically fail this saving throw and take maximum damage. For every creature that fails this save, you gain 5 temporary hit points.

Prerequisite: Must have Excavation

You have learned to increase the density of your stone creations. The amount of hit points each cube created by your Excavation now equals 10 times your CE modifier. Stone constructs created by your other Innate Technique features gain an additional 10 hit points.

Prerequisite: Must have Sculpted Earth

As a reaction, you can cause one of your stone constructs within 60 feet of you to explode. Any creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take 1d12 bludgeoning damage and are knocked prone. You can spend CE up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) as part of this reaction to heighten the explosion and deal an additional 1d12 bludgeoning damage per CE and cause creatures in range to take half as much damage on a success.

Prerequisite: Must have Stone Arms

You are no longer required to maintain concentration to maintain your Stone Arms. Additionally, while spending 1 CE each turn to maintain your hands, you are able to control your Stone Arms as if casting the spell Bigby’s Hand. A creature that gains the restrained condition from your Stone Arms has their movement speed halved for 1 minute or until they regain hit points.

Prerequisite: Must have Eight Lives

As an action for 4 cursed energy, you summon the scales of Yamata no Orochi to protect your flesh. Your AC cannot be lower than 14 + your proficiency bonus and you become resistant to poison and slashing damage for 1 hour.

Prerequisite: Must have Collective Will

When you use Eight Lives to return to life, you can gain resistance to one damage type that reduced you to 0 hit points or immunity to one harmful condition you had. This benefit lasts for 1 hour.

Prerequisite: Must have Fangs of Orochi

You have trained your technique to be more versatile in combat. You can wield Fangs or Orochi as a Dagger or Shortsword. On a hit with this weapon, a creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes an additional 2d6 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of their next turn. Your Fang Shikigami gain the following improvements:

  • The AC of your Fangs becomes 15 + your proficiency bonus.

  • Your Fangs deal an additional 2d4 poison damage on a hit.

Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Sacrifice

When you use Sacrifice and kill a humanoid, instead of gaining a life, you can summon a Head of Orochi as a shikigami under your control. You can control or unsummon the head as a bonus action or summon it as an action for 3 CE later, being stored somewhere on your body as a tattoo of the head of a snake. This replaces one of your Fangs of Orochi shikigami you can have active at once.

Once you have used Sacrifice to gain all eight heads, the tattoos come together to form a knot on your chest. As a Full-Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement), you can complete the ritual and incarnate the Special Grade Cursed Spirit: Yamata no Orochi as a shikigami in an unoccupied space within 10 ft of you.

Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Painting

You have learned to fold, expand, and even connect the subspaces of your paintings. When you enter one of your painting subspaces, you can spend 4 cursed energy to exit from one of your physical paintings. Additionally, the number of paintings you can have at once increases by your proficiency bonus and the area of your subspace doubles.

Prerequisite: Must have Impasto Canvas

As a reaction to an attack roll, you can spend 1 Cursed Energy to add +4 to your AC against the attack by forming a cursed painting, storing the attack in your subspace on a miss. If you have taken the dodge action, you can use this reaction on allies within 5 feet.
Once per turn when you take the Attack action, you can spend 1 cursed energy to replace one of your attacks on your turn with an attack from a Giant Ink Shikigami. Make a melee cursed energy attack against a creature you can see within 30 ft. You create a painting of cursed energy and one of your Ink Shikigami attacks from the painting, dealing 3d10 + your CE modifier necrotic damage on a hit. This increases to 4d10 at 6th level and 5d10 at 11th level.

Prerequisite: Must have Sgraffito

As an action for 5 cursed energy, you create a subspace Gradient that fills a 30 ft cube centered on you for 1 minute. You can use your innate technique features within this subspace, but they cannot extend beyond it and disappear once the technique ends. The subspace is stationary and does not move with you. At 11th level, you can increase the size of the cube to 60 ft.
Alternatively, instead of using your innate technique features within Gradient, you can instead enhance your spatial awareness. You gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures within the subspace. While Gradient is active, you can use your reaction to add your CE modifier to an attack roll, saving throw, or AC against one attack roll. While using Gradient this way, you cannot use Impasto Canvas.

Prerequisite: Must have Faster Throws

You have learned to minimize the damage you take when using your technique. You decrease the hit point loss from using any part of your body as an explosive by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 hit point).
At 6th level, this reduction increases to an amount equal to twice your Constitution modifier plus your level (minimum 1 hit point).

Prerequisite: Must have Guerilla Tactics

You have learned how to create different types of explosions, making them create different effects. You can spend additional cursed energy equal to the energy spent in using the bomb to make them an elemental bomb. The elemental bomb will deal additional dice of fire, cold or lightning damage, equal to the original bombs' damage.

Prerequisite: Must have Stronger Explosions

Your explosive prowess has reached new heights, allowing you to trigger massive blasts from your removed body parts. As an action, you can spend cursed energy equal to the body part to trigger a delayed explosion. Choose a body part you have removed within 30 ft. It detonates at the end of your next turn, forcing all creatures within 20 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage. On a failure, they take Xd12 force damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half damage and are not knocked prone. You can spend additional cursed energy up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to increase the damage by an additional Xd12 for every cursed energy spent. The X is your Cursed Energy modifier.

Prerequisite: Must have Store and Release

As a reaction to bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage, you can spend 1 cursed energy to reduce the incoming damage by your Cursed Energy score and gain 1 Jin Charge. You cannot reduce the damage of other damage types.

Prerequisite: Must have Instantaneous Movement

When you use at least 3 Jin charges for Instantaneous Movement, you gain advantage on your next melee attack roll. On a hit, you deal additional thunder damage equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.

Prerequisite: Must have Maximize Potential

You have learned the method to magnify your destructive power. As a bonus action, you can spend 2 CE before using Fist of Explosive Power. You deal three damage die per Jin charge spent and all targets gain a -3 to their saving throw, being launched back 10 feet on a failed save, taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage if they hit an object, creature or structure.

Prerequisite: Must have Madness Inducement

As a bonus action for 3 cursed energy, your face is adorned with a veil for 1 minute. A creature with at least 10% corruption that can see you must make an Intelligence saving throw at the beginning of their turn. On a failed save, they gain a -1 to all rolls for every 10% corruption they have until the start of their next turn (does not stack with Theia Mania). An affected creature repeats the save at the start of their turn, ending the effect on a success and automatically succeeds the save if it cannot see you.

Prerequisite: Must have Obsession and Insanity

As a bonus action for 3 cursed energy, you summon either the Left Hand or Right Hand for 10 minutes. Attacks made with a Hand of Madness increases Mental Corruption by 5% once per turn, even when your technique is not activated. You can only have one hand active at a time. At 11th level, you can spend 6 CE as a bonus action to use both.

Right Hand. The Right Hand of Madness covers your right hand. You and creatures with Mental Corruption see a horrid arm of rotting flesh, wriggling tendrils, or similarly terrifying to them. An unarmed strike made with your right hand can use your CE modifier for attack and damage rolls and deals 1d12 psychic damage on a hit. Attacks with the right hand have advantage on targets with 50% or more corruption.
Left Hand. The Left Hand of Madness covers your left hand. You and creatures with Mental Corruption see your normal arm, but it invokes an inexplicable sense of terror within them. An unarmed strike made with your left hand can use your CE modifier for attack and damage rolls and deals 1d6 psychic damage on a hit. On a hit, a creature must make a Wisdom saving throw or gain the frightened condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Rumination

A creature gains a temporary level of exhaustion while at 50% corruption or two levels of exhaustion at 100%.

Prerequisite: Must have Fate Manipulation

You or the DM chooses one creature you touch as your Destined One. You can always tell where your Destined One is as the thread of Fate always guides your hand. While within 30 ft of your Destined One, you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. Additionally, once per round you can add your proficiency bonus to your AC against an attack roll made against you or to a saving throw you make, potentially changing the outcome. You cannot change the creature chosen as your Destined One unless they die.

Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Eyes of Fate

When you cast a Fate onto targets, you can instead target a number of creatures equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus within range. If the Fate requires Touch, you must touch all targets of the technique.

system.requirements: Must have Cursed Eyes of Fate

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Road of Karma

As an action for 15 cursed energy, you form a scissor with your fingers and snip one of the threads of fate of a creature you can see within 5 ft of you. At the start of each of the target’s turns, they must make a Death saving throw. This roll cannot have advantage or disadvantage or any bonuses or penalties. The target gains 1 level of exhaustion for every failed death save. If the target fails 3 death saves, they fall to 0 hit points and die. They are unable to be revived by cursed techniques. If the target succeeds 3 death saves or you are reduced to 0 hit points or die, the technique ends and the target becomes immune to this technique for 3 days.

Prerequisite: Must have Predictable Strikes

Your foresight ability has reached even greater potential, reaching the point some consider enlightened. Whenever you have advantage because of your technique, you can roll 3 dice instead of 2 and keep the highest roll. Also, whenever a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you because of your technique, they roll 3 dice instead of 2 and keep the lowest roll.

Prerequisite: Must have Precognition

You have created a more powerful version of your G Warstaff, being a true weapon of destruction. As a bonus action while you have G Warstaff active, you can spend 4 cursed energy to evolve it into its true form, GG True Warstaff. It gains the following benefits for 1 minute:

  • It deals one additional damage dice

  • Its reach is 15ft instead of 10ft

  • When you score a critical hit against a creature, you gain 2 seconds instead of 1

  • It gains a +1 to critical range

Prerequisite: Must have Storyboard Dominion

You have gained the ability to not only see, but also manipulate the contents of your manga panel. At the beginning of your turn, you can choose a creature that you can see that is marked by 6 seconds and roll a d20. Record the roll. As a reaction, you can replace one roll that creature makes with the result of that roll. At the beginning of your turn, you lose any unused rolls.

Prerequisite: Must have Majestic Pose

You have learned to activate your technique in a fraction of a second.

  • When you use Golden Hour, you can instead use it as a free action on your turn instead of as a bonus action.

  • As a reaction for 5 CE, you can stop time for yourself and immediately take one turn. After time resumes, your movement is 0 ft and you cannot take actions until the end of your next turn.

  • At 6th level, you can use Golden Week as a bonus action instead of an action.

Prerequisite: Must have Golden Week

Instead of making your technique last longer, you can increase the intensity to create an even sharper burst. When you use Majestic Pose, you can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to instead quadruple your movement speed and gain a +5 bonus to attack rolls within stopped time. However, once time resumes you are unable to move or take actions until the end of your next turn, as a wave of lethargy sweeps over you.

Prerequisite: Must have Samsara Rewind

As a bonus action, you can spend 5 CE to summon the Clock Hand to your hands for 10 minutes. The Clock Hand counts as a Simple Melee weapon that you are proficient with and has the finesse and reach property. It deals 1d10 piercing damage on a hit and has the Hour Hand and Minute Hand properties while you (not others) wield it.

  • Hour Hand. If used against a creature in stopped time, the Clock Hand deals an additional 3d8 necrotic damage on a hit.

  • Minute Hand. If used against a creature not in stopped time, on a hit the creature must make a Cursed Energy save or be frozen in time and suffer the penalties of stopped time until the end of their next turn. This can only force a save once per round.

Prerequisite: Must have Scorpion Hair

You have trained with your hair and unlocked the following maneuvers:
Barbed Defense. As a reaction to being targeted by an attack, you can make a Scorpion Hair attack against the attacker if they are within range.
Hair Wrapping. On a hit with your Scorpion Hair, you can choose to deal no damage and instead grapple the creature. You can use your Cursed Energy modifier to make grapple checks with your hair.
Split Ends. Once per turn, when you hit with your Scorpion Hair, you can add your Cursed Energy modifier to the damage roll.

Prerequisite: Must have Drill Hair

You can now use more cursed energy to imbue one Mega-drill. As an action for 4 cursed energy, you can shoot this Mega-drill in a 5 ft wide, 80 ft long line. Creatures in this line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it deals 6d10 piercing damage. On a success, they take half the damage. This technique deals maximum damage to objects and structures and ignores half and three quarters cover. The damage of this technique increases to 8d10 at 6th level and becomes 10d10 at 11th level.

Prerequisite: Must have Aircraft Hair

You have learned the following destructive ways to amplify your Aircraft Hair forms:
Copter Frenzy. As an action for 5 CE, you force all creatures within 15 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save they take your Helicopter Hair damage. On a successful save, they take half as much.
Jet Crash. The damage a creature takes from impacting a solid surface from your crash increases to 1d6 per 10 ft traveled in a straight line before hitting the. This becomes 1d8 at 11th level and 1d10 at 18th level.

Prerequisite: Must have Hands of Love

You have mastered the basic use of your love hands. Whenever you Shove a creature, they are instead pushed 10 feet. When creatures are grappled or restrained, they take a d6 bludgeoning damage at the start of their turn. Structures also take maximum damage from your Love Hands.

Prerequisite: Must have Hand Shield

You use your Love Hands in new and innovative ways. As an action, you can make your Hands into a solid platform. This can be used for traversing, or area control and gives you and another creature that is large or smaller a hover speed of 15 ft while on it.

Prerequisite: Must have Cutie Honey

As an action for 8 CE, you can choose to instantly put a creature you can see under the effects of Cutie Honey without needing to restrain them.

Prerequisite: Must have Ice Creation

You have gained the ability to further shape your ice into a weapon. As an action for 1 Cursed Energy you can make a weapon made of ice or transform ice into a weapon for 1 minute. Once per turn, you can deal additional cold damage equal to your CE modifier on an attack made with that weapon.

Prerequisite: Must have Frost Calm

The cold of your ice has increased exponentially. While restrained by your ice, your opponent gains an additional temporary level of exhaustion and a -2 to attack rolls and ability checks.

Prerequisite: Must have Icefall

You now freeze through flesh and muscle. As an action while within 5 ft of a creature that is restrained by your ice, you can break off a limb that is not the head or torso (Using the limb damage table). The creature is then no longer restrained.

Prerequisite: Must have Transfiguration

You have mastered your observation of the soul and learned grotesque molds to shape them into. You gain the two of the following ways to use transfigured humans (this feat can be repeated):

  • Remote Transfiguration. When using Transfiguration, you can instead imprint a small, latent amount of cursed energy upon their souls, allowing you to transfigure them from large distances (only one touch per creature).

  • Wall of Flesh. As an action, you spend humans up to your proficiency bonus to form a flat panel of human flesh up to 5 ft long and wide per human used in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. The wall’s AC equals your CE save DC and has hit points equal to 5 x the combined CR of the creatures used. You can move it 5 ft as a bonus action and can have only one wall at a time.

  • Human Weapon. As a bonus action, you form a creature into a simple or martial weapon or ammunition. The weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls if the creature’s CR is 5 or higher and increases by +1 per 5 CR to a maximum of +4.

  • People Spikes. As an action, you spend humans up to your proficiency bonus, covering a 5 ft area per human on the ground within 30 ft of you with human spikes. A creature that walks through this area takes 2d8 piercing damage.

Prerequisite: Must have Alteration

When you use Ally-Alteration on a Non-Sorcerer, you can instead spend 10 cursed energy to awaken the sorcerer, making a DC 25 Cursed Energy check to awaken the target. On a success, their potential grows over the course of 1d4 + 4 days, gaining a level in a Jujutsu Sorcerer class of the DM’s choice. Roll a d100 to see if the target has an Innate Technique despite being a Non-Sorcerer. On a 99-100, the target has an innate technique.
If you roll below a 15 on the Cursed Energy check, the target takes your Transfiguration damage, potentially making the target into a transfigured human.

Prerequisite: Must have Body Clone

Your manipulation over your soul has increased dramatically, making you almost impossible to kill by those who cannot target your soul. When you use Self-Alteration, you can instead spend cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to regain 5 hit points per cursed energy spent. You can regrow a limb for every 2 cursed energy spent in this way. At 11th level, this instead becomes 10 hit points per CE, can be used as a reaction to damage, and costs 1 CE to regrow limbs.
When you are reduced to 0 hit points while you have at least 1 CE, by a method that does not directly harm your soul, you are instead incapacitated until you regain hit points and do not make death saves. While incapacitated in this way, the only action you can take is to use Soul Alteration as an action.

documents.name: Maximum: Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Self Embodiment of Perfection

As an action for 8 cursed energy, you mold your body and soul into a form most befitting you. A form suited for killing. For 1 hour, your AC cannot be lower than 25 and you gain damage reduction equal to your CE modifier as your body has become impossibly hard and dense. Additionally, you gain elbow blades that count as simple melee weapons that you are proficient with. They deal 1d12 + your Cursed Energy modifier in piercing damage on a hit. When you make an attack with your Elbow Blades, you can spend 1 cursed energy to gain advantage on and increase the range of the attack to 15 feet as the Elbow Blade extends and shoots out at the target.

system.requirements: Must have Self Embodiment of Perfection

features: Domain Expansion: Self Embodiment of Perfection

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Illusion

You have learned to add a bit of humor to your technique. When a cursed creature sees a distorted face, you can spend 2 CE to force the Intelligence saving throw to be made at disadvantage by making the face look extra goofy. Additionally, you can spend 1 CE to change the distortion, causing them to have to make an additional Intelligence save on their next turn if they see a distorted face.

Prerequisite: Must have Self Distortion

You have begun to work on your tracking skills over your illusions so you can track your targets at all times.
When someone is cursed by your technique you can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to forgo the effects of the illusions but enhance the tracking. Somewhere on the target's body, a mark appears out of sight without their knowledge. They can make an Investigation check against your Cursed Energy DC to become aware of the curse or if someone else points it out. This mark will last for 24 hours and while it’s active you will always have a precise location of the target within a range of 300 ft + your proficiency bonus x 100 ft. At the beginning of each day you can spend 5 Cursed Energy to keep it active for another 24 hours.
If a target leaves your range, you cannot track them until they reenter your range. You cannot extend your tracking period if they are not within range.

activation.condition: When someone is cursed by your technique you can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to...

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Illusive Terrain

For 10 cursed energy, you can force a creature in range to make a Cursed Energy saving throw at disadvantage. On a failure, you completely fool all of their senses for 1 minute. You can freely create illusions around the target as if they are under your Cursed Illusion or Illusive Terrain. They automatically fail checks to determine the illusions are fake as their mind rationalizes any inconsistencies. Additionally, the target believes so strongly that your illusions are real that they can actually take damage. Once per turn if you create a harmful illusion, the target can take psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus in d6s.

Prerequisite: Must have Extreme Opposites

You have fully mastered your Inverse technique, allowing you to withstand devastating attacks while weak strikes take a heavy toll. When you take damage, the effect depends on whether it exceeds or falls below your threshold.
If the damage exceeds your threshold, you reduce it by an amount equal to your level. However, if the damage is below your threshold, you increase the damage taken by an amount equal to your level. This makes you near-invulnerable to powerful blows, but even the lightest strike can prove perilous.

Prerequisite: Must have Quick Inversion

While training on your technique, you have found out you have a lot more to offer than just being an indestructible powerhouse. You have learned how to alter a whole area to be affected by your technique. As a bonus action for 6 cursed energy, you cause all objects and creatures within 30 ft of you to be affected by your Inverse technique for 1 minute. A creature or object is no longer affected by Inverse if they leave the range of the field. You can deactivate this as a bonus action.

Prerequisite: Must have Synesthesia

You’ve learned to channel your inverted energy outward, inverting the flow of harm itself while your Inverse is active:

  • When you take damage within your threshold, you can spend 4 CE as a reaction to reflect half of that damage back to the attacker (damage becomes force or necrotic, your choice) if they are within 30 ft.

  • When you take damage below your threshold, you can instead spend 1 CE as a free action to transfer the pain. Choose a creature within 30 ft to take force or necrotic damage (your choice) equal to twice your CE modifier.

Prerequisite: Must have Demonic Intellect

Through refining your ability, you have become more skilled in using your technique in combat and can add your Intelligence modifier to Initiative rolls. Additionally, when using Demonic Intellect, you gain the following additional benefits:

  • You add your proficiency bonus to any saving throws you make if you don’t already.

  • You can spend 1 CE to gain an additional reaction each round.

  • Once per round you can add your Intelligence modifier to a damage roll you make.

Prerequisite: Must have Future and Past

Your brain has begun to acclimate to the constant amount of information being calculated. Your Intelligence score increases by 3 and you gain proficiency in either History, Investigation, Arcana, Religion, or Nature. Your Intelligence score increases by 1 again at 6th, 11th, and 18th level. Your maximum score for Intelligence is now 24.

Prerequisite: Must have Overload

You focus your mind for 1 minute and spend 5 cursed energy. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The DM offers a truthful reply.
The answer doesn’t take into account any possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as additional glimpses of the future or the loss or gain of a companion. Between now and the predicted event, you gain an insight of knowledge that grants you advantage on one roll of your choice. You cannot have more than one insight at a time.

Prerequisite: Must have Lapse Blue

Through intense training and familiarizing yourself with your technique, you have gained the ability to apply Blue to your fists. Once per turn, when you make an unarmed strike, by spending cursed energy you can make them suffer the effects of Lapse Blue on a hit. For this attack you can use your cursed energy modifier for attack rolls. When you use Blue in this way, the target takes additional damage equal to Lapse Blue on a hit and you gain advantage on that attack roll as your technique attracts the target.
If you have access to Reversal Red, you can also imbue Red to your fists. When you use Red in this way, the target takes additional damage equal to Reversal Red on a hit and must make a Strength saving throw or be launched the same distance as a normal Red.

Prerequisite: Must have Lapse Blue and Reversal Red

You have learned how to mix positive and negative space, creating imaginary mass. After using your action to prepare the technique, you can release it as an action for 10 Cursed Energy. Every creature in a 5 feet wide 100-foot line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 20d12 force damage, are moved to the end of the line, gain 1 level of exhaustion and you can target a limb from the Limb Damage Table. On a successful save, they take half as much damage.

system.requirements: Must have Lapse Blue and Reversal Red

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Hollow Purple

You have found a new more powerful way to fire Purple. As a reaction or action when a Blue is active, you can shoot a Red into it if it is within range. This forcefully creates a Hollow Purple that affects everything in a 100 foot radius around the source. This Hollow Purple deals maximum damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. You must also make a saving throw if you are within range. This technique cannot be used at Maximum Output.

Prerequisite: Must have Effective Marking

Your reaction speed has further increased. At the cost of one CE, you gain the ability to use the reactions from effective markings for other purposes.

Prerequisite: Must have Gravity

You have gained further variety with your Marks and the forces within it. As a bonus action for up to 3 CE you can force marked creatures to be repelled from the creature with the highest amount of CE. How far depends on how much CE you use, with them moving 10 feet for every CE. They take 2d8 bludgeoning damage if the repelled movement forces them into a structure, object, or creature.

Prerequisite: Must have Shining Star

As an action for 10 CE, you push yourself and mark a creature you touch with all your power. Marking a creature this way, attracts one body into itself causing massive damage. When you activate this, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 25d4 force damage and a level of exhaustion on a failed save or half as much on a success.

Prerequisite: Must have Little Miracles

You have learned to more efficiently store up luck. You can now store an additional number of Miracles equal to your CE modifier.

Prerequisite: Must have Miraculous Outcome

When you or a creature you can see fails a death saving throw, you can spend 1 Miracle and 1 CE as a reaction. The roll is now considered a natural 20. You cannot experience a breakthrough or gain a Miracle in this way.

Prerequisite: Must have Fated for Fortune

Some have asked you: "Are you lucky because you have miracles by your side, or do you have miracles by your side because you're lucky?" The answer was obvious, you are naturally lucky and your technique merely reflects that. You roll all dice generated by your cursed technique twice, picking the result of the higher one. Additionally, you can make a miracle die roll its maximum amount once per long rest.

Prerequisite: Must have Missile Impact

You have learned to channel your passion for battle and fighting spirit into your cursed technique. When you hit a creature with Missile Fist, all creatures within 5 ft (other than you) take thunder damage equal to your CE modifier from the shockwaves. You can use this effect a number of times each turn equal to your proficiency bonus. When you hit a target with a Missile Fist, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against that target. This bonus can stack and lasts until the end of your turn.

effects.name: Exploding Fighting Spirit (toggle)
effects.description: Conditional bonus: enable this effect while its condition applies.

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Devastating Barrage

As a bonus action for 2 CE, you cover your hands in Missile Fists, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

  • You gain a +2 bonus to AC while holding no weapons or shields.

  • You can use your CE modifier for attack and damage rolls using your unarmed strikes.

  • Your unarmed strikes deal your Missile Fist damage.

  • The range of your unarmed strikes becomes 10 ft.

effects.name: Armored Missile Fist (toggle)
effects.description: Conditional bonus: enable this effect while its condition applies.

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Unrelenting Fury

As a reaction for 3 CE, when you or a creature within 30 ft would take damage, you interpose a Missile Fist, reducing the damage by your Missile Fist damage.

Prerequisite: Must have Lunar Jellyfish

You have learned to reinforce your shikigami with cursed energy. As part of the bonus action to command Moon Dregs, you can spend cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to give Moon Dregs 5 temporary hit points per Cursed Energy spent. This increases to 10 temporary hit points per cursed energy at 11th level.

Prerequisite: Must have Poisonous Cursed Energy

You have learned to refine your poisons within Moon Dregs to create powerful mixtures. You gain the following benefits:

  • Moon Dregs deals an additional 1d6 poison damage on a hit. This increases to 2d6 at 6th level and 3d8 at 11th level.

  • A creature grappled by Moon Dregs takes 2d4 poison damage at the beginning of their turn. This increases to 2d8 poison damage at 11th level.

  • Poison can also be used as an enhancer. You gain 4 ability points you can use to increase Moon Dregs ability scores (max of 20).

Prerequisite: Must have Cleansing of Purity

You have finally learned to amplify your poisonous cursed energy into a crippling neurotoxin that locks down nerves. When you use Poisonous Cursed Energy, you can spend 8 additional cursed energy to enhance the poison. If a creature fails their save against Noxious Poison they are stunned until the end of their next turn and poisoned for 8 hours. On a successful save, the target is poisoned for 1 minute. A creature poisoned in this way is treated as being under 3 temporary levels of exhaustion. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, they are paralyzed until the end of their next turn and poisoned for 24 hours.
This poison ignores cursed techniques that grant resistance, immunity, or other reductions to poison damage and the poisoned condition. This poison cannot be removed by cursed techniques or reverse cursed technique.

Prerequisite: Must have Electric Energy

Your Cursed Energy has gained a defensive property. As a reaction to being hit by a melee attack, you can spend 2 CE to force the attacker to make a Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature is stunned until the beginning of their next turn.

Prerequisite: Must have Lightning Discharge

You have learned how to further manipulate your lightning. On a hit with a melee attack using a weapon it also gains a charge, and as a bonus action you can release a bolt of lightning between the weapon and yourself. Those caught in that bolt of lightning must make a Dexterity save, taking your Lightning Discharge damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

Prerequisite: Must have Mythical Beast Amber Release

Through repeated usage of your cursed technique's release your body has grown used to the manifestation of phenomena. The side effects of using Mythical Beast Amber: Release are reduced by 1 stage. This causes stage 0 to have no side effects.

system.requirements: Must have Mythical Beast Amber Release

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have New Shadow Style: Simple Domain

Your Simple Domain now has additional hit points equal to twice your Cursed Energy modifier.

system.requirements: Must have New Shadow Style: Simple Domain

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Batto Sword Draw

You have learned the fastest way to draw defensively. Once per round after activating Simple Domain, you can make a melee attack against someone who enters it.

Prerequisite: Must have Evening Moon Sword Drawing

You have honed your reaction speed to the finest edge. When you roll initiative you can activate Simple Domain or make an attack as a free action.

system.requirements: Must have Evening Moon Sword Drawing

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Moonlight Veil

As an action for up to 6 cursed energy, you create up to 6 smaller Simple Domains on the ground within 30 ft of yourself that each cover a 5 ft space for 1 minute. Each Maculation functions as a Simple Domain with hit points equal to 5 x your proficiency bonus. While standing in a space with Maculation, you can use your reaction to either gain a +3 bonus to AC or reduce incoming damage by your weapon's damage until the beginning of your next turn. A Maculation disappears if you end your turn more than 30 ft away from one.

Prerequisite: Must have Great Luck

Your luck seems to spread to those around you. You can use Great Luck on another creature of your choice instead of yourself.

Prerequisite: Must have Idle Death Gamble

Through thorough understanding of your domain, you can now manifest Pachinko Attacks outside your domain and have a 30 foot range when used this way. Whenever you use a Pachinko Attack, you add your Cursed Energy modifier to the damage rolls. Additionally, you reduce the Cursed Energy cost of your Pachinko Attacks by 1 CE. This reduces the CE cost of Green Balls to 0 CE, but cannot reduce the CE cost of other Pachinko Attacks to 0 CE (minimum of 1). These attacks do not build Expectation.

Prerequisite: Must have The Fever

You have fully understood the essence of your technique. As an action for 10 Cursed Energy, you can summon the Love Train. This is a 200 foot long, 20 feet wide Line attack in which a creature within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they are launched 200 feet and take 15d6 bludgeoning damage. The train is summoned on a space of your choice within 30ft, and the opponent is launched in the opposite direction.

Prerequisite: Must have Pain Killer

A creature under the effects of Pain Killer now gains additional temporary hit points equal to 5 times your proficiency bonus.

Prerequisite: Must have Practiced Hands

A creature now gains the benefits of Pain Killer for 24 hours and is automatically stabilized if they are reduced to 0 hit points while under the effect.

Prerequisite: Must have Analgesic

As a reaction to a creature within 10 feet (including yourself) falling to 0 hit points you can spend 4 CE and cause them to instead remain at 10 hit points and gain the benefits of Pain Killer.

Prerequisite: Must have Immobilizing Eyes

When you use Immobilizing Eyes, you can spend 1 additional CE as part of activating the technique concentrate your eyes on a specific part of the creature, also causing one of the following restrictions while you maintain your technique:

  • Legs. The target’s speed is halved. If the target tries to move more than their movement speed, they must make a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

  • Arms. The target gains an additional -3 penalty to attack rolls and cannot take object interactions.

  • Torso. You reduce the target’s AC by 3.

Prerequisite: Must have Peripheral Vision

As part of your bonus action while maintaining your technique on a creature, the target takes 2d8 psychic damage. This increases to 2d10 at 6th level, 4d8 at 11th level, and 6d8 at 18th level.

Prerequisite: Must have Reactive Eye Movement

Through constant exposure, your eyes have become surprisingly tough. Whenever your eyes take damage, the damage is halved. When your eyes’ hit points would be reduced to 0 hit points, you can make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw for your eyes to stay at 1 hit point. If you have Reverse Cursed Technique, you automatically succeed. You can make this saving throw a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus each long rest.

Prerequisite: Must have Marcado

Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack while Prayer is active, you can spend 3 CE to deal maximum damage.

Prerequisite: Must have Caesura

You put a full stop to the rhythm of your enemy. As a reaction, you can spend 3 CE to make an attack miss, or spend 5 CE to make a creature fail a saving throw.

Prerequisite: Must have Crescendo

As an action for 3 CE, you double the tempo of your song and the battle. You treat every turn as if two turns passed.

Prerequisite: Must have Acceleration

As a reaction to an attack or damaging effect, you can spend 2 cursed energy to create a number of blank animation frames to absorb any damage. Roll a number of d10s equal to 2 + your CE modifier. Any damage you take before the start of your next turn instead damages these blank frames, but you take any remaining damage.

Prerequisite: Must have 24 Frames Rule

As an action for 4 cursed energy, you create a 5 ft wide, 30 foot long line of frames in the air that you explosively break. All creatures in that line must make a Dexterity saving throw or take a number d10s in force damage equal to your CE modifier and are knocked prone. On a failed save, they take half as much damage.

Prerequisite: Must have Fastest Sorcerer Alive

When you activate your cursed energy you can force it past its limit for short periods of time. For an additional cursed energy per round, you also gain the following effects in addition to the other effects of your technique:

  • Your speed is doubled

  • You gain advantage on Dexterity saves

  • Your Dexterity score increases by +2, ignoring your maximum

  • An additional action on each of your turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack action (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

Prerequisite: Must have Ultimate Mechamaru

As an action, you can wear one of your puppets within 5 ft. This gives you your puppets HP as temporary hit points, as well as traits and physical ability scores and also increases your AC by 2. You can only wear one Puppet at a time and cannot command this Puppet.

Prerequisite: Must have Lesser Puppet

After one long rest, you create a small puppet that can fit on the palm of your hand. This puppet holds a copy of consciousness when you created it and has enough charge for five minutes. You can have a number equal to your proficiency bonus and anything learned by one is shared to all. These can be activated as a free action or set to activate after a specific trigger.

Prerequisite: Must have Absolute Puppet

You gain the ability to make a puppet of your Ultimate Puppet. This puppet can have double the traits, however it also costs double the resources, time, and Cursed Energy to create.

Prerequisite: Must have Critical Focus

You gain a +1 bonus to your critical range.

Prerequisite: Must have Collapse

You focus your Ratio on your opponent’s weapon. When you are targeted by a weapon attack, you can spend 5 CE as a reaction to create and hit a vulnerable ratio point on their weapon, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure the weapon breaks. If the weapon is a cursed tool, you must use a tool of equal or greater rank to break it, otherwise the attack fails. If used against an unarmed strike, it is treated as a limb damaging effect using the Limb Damage table. Roll critical damage with your weapon. If you deal the required damage, you break the limb. Either way, the target takes no damage and this feature cannot remove a limb.

Prerequisite: Must have Improved Ratio

For an additional 6 Cursed Energy, when you land a critical hit using ratio your target automatically loses a limb that is not the head or torso, using the limb damage table.

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Regalia

You have learned to alter your regalia and can change it to a different type of weapon as a bonus action, including ranged weapons and shields. While your Regalia is a ranged weapon, it creates its own ammunition. While it is a shield, you gain a bonus to AC while wielding equal to the bonus to attack and damage rolls your regalia has. Your GM may also choose to allow more unique weapons or items.

Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Wave

While you have your Regalia manifested, you can spend 3 CE as a bonus action to summon a hagoromo scarf around your body that lasts until your Regalia disappears. As a reaction, you can add your proficiency bonus to your AC until the beginning of your next turn, or to a saving throw you make as the silken scarf protects you from harm.

Prerequisite: Must have Soul Bound Treasure

You have learned to apply your soul control to a wide area, turning everything within your sight into a Lesser Regalia that obeys your will. As an action for 8 CE, you turn nonmagical objects around you that are not being worn or carried into Lesser Regalia that destroy what lies before you. This creates a 60 ft cone originating from you. Any creatures within range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d10 necrotic damage and be pushed back 30 feet and knocked prone on a failed save or half as much and not pushed back or prone on a successful save. A creature that is pushed back and impacts a solid object or structure takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. Objects and structures in range take maximum damage. A creature that fails their save against this technique has their maximum hit points reduced by the damage taken until they finish a long rest. If the creature failed their save, this damage cannot be reduced.

Prerequisite: Must have Reversion

As an action while touching part of a nonliving object that was destroyed an hour ago, you can spend 2 cursed energy to entirely repair it. Any other fragments or separated parts of it disappear and any destroyed parts reform for the object. At 6th level this increases to 1 day, at 8th level this increases to 7 days, at 11th level this increases to 1 month, at 18th level this becomes 1 year and at 20th level this increases to any point in time.

Prerequisite: Must have Regression

What if we just went backwards, like really fast? When you use Regression, you no longer provoke opportunity attacks during your regressing movement. Additionally, you can instead spend up to your proficiency bonus in cursed energy. If you spend more than 1 CE, you gain a +1 bonus to the DC or Cursed Energy check per Cursed Energy spent. At 11th level, you can push creatures Huge or smaller out of your path.

Prerequisite: Must have Invert Causality

When you use Invert Causality, your guaranteed attack deals critical damage (cannot roll black flash) and the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are stunned until the end of your next turn.

Prerequisite: Must have Sound Waves

You've learned that just playing isn't enough, you need to build up to the best part. As an action you can start playing your instrument to charge up your technique. You can charge your technique using your action this way for a number of times equal to your CE modifier while concentrating, after which you must release your technique. You can use your reaction to launch either a Sound Blast or Sound Wave at any time while playing this way and add 2 damage die per action you use to play before releasing and ignore resistances.

Prerequisite: Must have Resonating Music

As a bonus action for 5 cursed energy, you can introduce a vibe of your choice for 1 minute while concentrating. You can only have one Vibe active at a time. Deafened creatures automatically succeed.
Happy Vibes. Your music gives happy and upbeat vibes. On a hit with your Sound Blast, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or be Charmed and only hear you and your music until the Vibe ends. They can repeat the save at the beginning of their turn.
Sad Vibes. Your music gives sad and depressed vibes, bringing the mood down. On a hit with your Sound Blast, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or fall prone and their speed becomes 0 until the Vibe ends. They can repeat the save at the beginning of their turn.
Angry Vibes. Your music gives off angry and rebellious vibes! On a hit with your Sound Blast, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or becomes berserk until the Vibe ends. A berserk creature uses their reaction to make a melee attack at the closest creature at the start of their turn and must use their action to attack. They can repeat the save at the beginning of their turn.

Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Epic Solo

Looks like the band is getting back together! An epic guitar solo is always welcome, but people came for a show. When an allied creature ends their turn within 15 feet of you during your Epic Solo, their next attack or technique deals additional d4 in thunder damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

Prerequisite: Must have Rot Techniques

You have found a way to link your blood to Cursed Energy. For 1 CE, you can create a sufficient source of blood worth 10 HP that can only be used for your Rot features. This does not regain HP.

Prerequisite: Must have Scarlet Rot

You have learned to increase the potency of your blood’s properties. When you use a Rot Technique, you can spend additional HP up to twice your CE modifier to increase the damage dice of acid dealt by your technique by one tier for every 2 HP spent (d8<d10<d12) to a max of d12.

Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Wing King

Your blood has become bubbling and black. A creature that fails a Constitution saving throw against your technique by 5 or more gains a level of exhaustion. A creature cannot gain more than 3 levels of exhaustion from this feature.

Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Wing King

You have mastered your Maximum technique, granting you the following benefits while using Wing King:

  • You gain the Evasion feature

  • You can now make four lines of blood attacks as a free action on your turn

  • You can use a Rot Technique as a bonus action

Prerequisite: Must have Piercing Schrift

You have perfected your accuracy and combined it with your piercing ability. When you use Piercing Schrift, you can also target additional targets up to your proficiency bonus that are either in front of or behind your target as long as they are within the path of the attack. You use the attack roll against the original target to determine if you would hit the additional targets.

Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Mark

Through diligent practice and creativity, you have created new types of cursed seals. You gain the following options:

  • Blinding Mark: As a bonus action for 3 CE, you mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. On a hit, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turn, removing the blinded condition on a success.

  • Crippling Mark: As a bonus action for 3 CE, you mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. On a hit, the target must make a Constitution saving throw or have either their movement speed halved for 1 minute or disadvantage on attacks for 1 minute (your choice). A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turn, ending the effect on a success.

Prerequisite: Must have Intangibility

You have practiced and mastered your technique allowing you to utilize it flawlessly. When you activate Intangibility, you are instead resistant to all damage other than psychic, but are still able to use your Innate Technique features and for the duration you can use Piercing Schrift for free once per turn.

Prerequisite: Must have Seance

You have learned to bring a bit of whimsy to your usually ghastly technique. When you use Seance on yourself, you can choose to instead channel the Physical Information of a Beast with a CR equal to or less than your proficiency bonus. You gain all the creature’s traits, senses, movements and actions in addition to the normal effects of Physical Information. To use this technique, you must be wearing a costume of that specific animal, costing $200 x the Beast’s CR. You can wear this costume with armor, but if it takes an amount of damage (other than psychic) equal to 3 x your level, it becomes unusable and you lose any benefits from this feature.

Prerequisite: Must have Ritual of Resurrection

Additionally, you decrease the saving throw DC a target makes against the dead humanoid’s Soul Information by your CE modifier.

Prerequisite: Must have Shadow Strike

As an action while the technique is active, you can move into a shadow within 10 ft. You can hear and see through the shadow you entered. If the shadow is sufficiently illuminated, you exit the shadow. (X = CE mod)

  • Shadow Envoy. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you can imbue your cursed energy into a creature's shadow within 5 ft. To attempt this technique without them noticing, you must make a Cursed Energy check against their passive perception. You can imbue conditions for when the technique is triggered. You can choose to leave either a melee attack with a range of 10 ft using Shadow Strike or a simple message. If you choose to leave a Shadow Strike, it targets a specific creature under a condition you set, uses your Cursed Energy modifier and is made at advantage if the target is unaware.   • A creature must spend an attack to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to remove the weapon.

  • The target is treated as having two levels of exhaustion.

  • The target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of their turn or be stunned until the beginning of their next turn.

A creature that enters the 30 ft sphere the dark sun inhabits takes 4d6 necrotic damage and and again at the start of their turns. At the end of the minute, you can spend 1 cursed energy to increase the duration by 1 minute. The technique ends if you become incapacitated. You're grown more efficient with your teleports and have perfected their efficiency to reduce cursed energy costs. The cost to use your technique instead becomes 1 CE and the cost to cast Teleport is reduced by your CE modifier.

With creative thinking you’ve figured out teleporting the souls of creatures. As an action for 6 CE with two willing creatures you touch, you mark and swap the souls of the creatures. For 1 hour or until you dismiss it (no action required), all of the creatures’ game statistics are swapped except for mental stats (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma) and any non-Physical feats. They lose access to their Innate Technique features and gain the other’s Technique and cursed energy, hit points, racial features, and weapon proficiencies.

Your Tsukumogami is always under the effects of Floating Tool and can freely move by itself. It does not count against the number of Floating Tools you can have at once, but you can only have one Tsukumogami at a time.
The Tsukumogami can take an action on your turn while you are holding it. If you use Wind Scythe or Combat Tool Improvement’s reaction with your Tsukumogami, you can roll three additional dice.

Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Heavenly Restriction or Heavenly Pact refers to a binding vow forced on a sorcerer's body at birth. This usually affects their cursed energy in exchange for limitations or improvements on their body. The most notable is the absolute physicality of Zenin Toji, but there are many different types of Heavenly Pacts. A creature can only have one Heavenly Pact. If the limitations of the Heavenly Pact are superseded, anything gained becomes null.

The body of the sorcerer only produces positive energy instead of negative energy, making them incredibly effective against cursed spirits in exchange for being unable to use cursed energy in normal ways. They cannot use features requiring cursed energy and instead have Reverse Cursed Energy equal to their normal cursed energy.

  • They are ineligible for Cursed Energy, Barrier, or Innate Technique feats due to the unique property of their cursed energy preventing them from utilizing it properly.

  • They gain Reverse Cursed Technique as well as the Cursed Technique Reversal and Reverse Cursed Technique Output Feats. For these features, one Reverse Cursed Energy counts as two CE.

  • Instead of being able to use their normal innate technique features, they instead gain the Reversal of their technique. Cursed Strike is replaced with Reverse Cursed Strike:

  • Reverse Cursed Strike. On a hit with an unarmed strike or melee weapon attack, you can spend Reverse Cursed Energy up to proficiency bonus to deal an additional 2d6 radiant damage per RCE.

The most notable is the absolute physicality of Zenin Toji, but there are many different types of Heavenly Pacts. A creature can only have one Heavenly Pact. If the limitations of the Heavenly Pact are superseded, anything gained becomes null.

Though the Heavenly Restriction of Zenin Toji is widely considered to be the strongest, it is impossibly rare and considered an enigma. The Limited Cursed Energy restriction is still rare, but more common. A person with this Heavenly Restriction has lower than average cursed energy and will heavily struggle to utilize it properly. Depending on how much their Heavenly Restriction limits them, their physical attributes increase accordingly.

CE Limitation Physical Increase
You do not add your CE modifier to your CE max +2 ASI
You only gain +1 CE per 2 levels +2 ASI, +1 HP per level
You cannot utilize Basic CE Manipulation +4 ASI
You cannot see Cursed Spirits normally +4 ASI
You cannot utilize Cursed Energy in any way +14 ASI, +2 HP per level

  • When you increase an Ability Score with this Heavenly Restriction, you cannot increase it above 24 (26 at 6th level).

  • If you choose the inability to utilize CE in any way, you still possess the CE of an ordinary person. However you cannot have an Innate Technique, but gain a Physical or Skill feat at the level you would gain an Innate Technique feature.

  • If you choose the inability to utilize CE in any way, you are ineligible for the first 3 CE Limitations. You instead gain a Physical Feat of your choice at 6th, 10th and 14th level.

If the limitations of the Heavenly Pact are superseded, anything gained becomes null.

Though many Heavenly Restrictions restrict cursed energy to strengthen the body, it is not uncommon for the opposite to occur. A person with this Heavenly Restriction has higher than average cursed energy with decreased physical abilities, sometimes to their extreme detriment. Depending on how much their Heavenly Restriction limits them, their cursed energy increases accordingly.

  • You cannot decrease an Ability score below 4 using this Heavenly Restriction.

  • For every Physical Limitation you choose you gain a +30 ft bonus to range for one of your cursed techniques. Additionally, when using a feature depending on your CE modifier, you count it as 1 higher for every Physical Limitation (Save DC, attacks, etc).

People with this Heavenly Restriction are unable to be healed by any means and must rely on their body’s natural recovery in order to heal wounds. This does not stop them from receiving other benefits of cursed techniques, it specifically prevents healing.

Healing Limitation

  • You are unable to regain hit points or remove conditions via cursed techniques or reverse cursed technique.

  • Any attempt to heal you causes the cursed energy to be wasted and you take necrotic damage equal to the CE spent.

Sturdiness Increase

In exchange for being incompatible with restorative techniques, your body is naturally sturdy and hard to take down.

  • When you expend a hit die to regain hit points, you gain twice the amount.

  • You have advantage on Death saves.

  • You gain a bonus to your maximum HP equal to twice your level.

  • When reduced to 0 hit points, you can remain at 1 hit point once per long rest. Increases to twice at 5th level and 4 times at 11th level.

  • At 6th level, it takes twice the damage to injure or remove a limb when targeted by a limb removing effect.

Uses: 1 (set it to 2 at 5th level and 4 at 11th level for the 'remain at 1 hit point' benefit).

People with this Heavenly Restriction find themselves constantly flowing with cursed energy and rarely run out. However, their body emits a scent that makes them tantalizing to cursed spirits.

Cursed Spirit Attraction

  • Any cursed spirit within 120 ft is automatically aware of your presence and feels drawn to you.

  • A cursed spirit that starts its turn within 60 ft of you must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the cursed spirit is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, it will ignore creatures other than you and attempt to attack you. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, it goes into a frenzy and has advantage on attacks against you.

Overgeneration Increase

  • You regain 1 CE every hour you do not have the incapacitated condition.

  • When you take a short rest, you can spend your hit die to regain Cursed Energy equal to your CE modifier for every hit die spent.

Creeps and Curses V.3.1

A Cursed Womb is still growing and will eventually achieve maturity naturally or through growth. You can choose Evolutionary Constraints upon character creation. These will eventually become your strength as you experience Truth Rebirth and shed your status as a Cursed Womb.

Evolutionary Constraint Effect
Soft Shell Your AC equals 10 + your Constitution modifier (min of +0) while not wearing armor. You do not gain the benefits of Unarmored Defense.
Weak Constitution Your hit point maximum decreases by an amount equal to 1-3 times your level and decreases by 1-3 whenever you gain a level.
Lacking Affinity You can not heal via Cursed Energy Affinity at level 5.
No ASI You do not gain your Racial ASI.
Weak CE You do not add your Cursed Energy modifier to your total Cursed Energy.
Slow Your walking speed is lowered by 5 or 10 ft.
Sedentary Your walking speed becomes 20 ft.
Small Body Your size is Small and you have disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws.

True Rebirth. You experience your first growth pangs at 8th level, and become a true Curse at 11th level and are truly reborn into this world.
